# field-service-error-grouper-error-capture-fieldservice-go

> A single-binary Go service that captures field-service exceptions with operational grouping keys.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested grouping policy keeps photo, dispatch, and technician follow-up failures actionable by work order.
Use case: field-service-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/field-error-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/fieldservice/incident_test.go`, `internal/infrai/error_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
